title: Qualifying Test, Repeat Test and Written Order Values — Home Oxygen Therapy Coverage Criteria
content:
# Coverage Criteria Values — Home Oxygen Therapy

The saturation values, test windows and written-order values used in qualifying a patient for Home Oxygen Therapy are fixed per system class as follows.

## Saturation and test windows

| System class | Group I: saturation at or below (percent) | Group II: qualifying saturation value with a documented qualifying comorbidity (percent) | Test performed within (calendar days before the order date) | Group II repeat test: earliest day of therapy | Group II repeat test: latest day of therapy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | 88 | 89 | 30 | 61 | 90 |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 88 | 89 | 30 | 61 | 90 |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | 88 | 89 | 30 | 61 | 90 |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | 88 | 89 | 30 | 61 | 90 |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | 88 | 89 | 30 | 61 | 90 |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 88 | 89 | 30 | 61 | 90 |

The days of therapy are counted with the setup date being day 1. The latest day is the latest day of therapy for the group II repeat test supporting payment from month 4.

## Portable mobility documentation and written orders

| System class | Portable equipment billable only when mobility within the home is documented | Written order usable to start therapy for (calendar months) | Change of flow, usage pattern or system class needs a new written order |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | no | 12 | yes |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | yes | 12 | yes |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | yes | 12 | yes |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | yes | 12 | yes |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | yes | 12 | yes |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | yes | 12 | yes |

## Reading the values (hypothetical results)

- A hypothetical test result of 88 percent is at or below the group I value of 88; a result of 89 percent is not at or below 88, and equals the group II value of 89, which counts under group II only with a documented qualifying comorbidity.
- The group II values describe a single saturation value (89), not a range.
- Day 61 and day 90 of therapy both lie within the repeat-test window; day 60 and day 91 lie outside it. With a hypothetical setup date of 1 March as day 1, day 61 falls on 30 April and day 90 on 29 May.
